data.gender_notes: Nabhya is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nabhya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Nabhah’ which means ‘Lord of the Navel’. In Hindu mythology, the navel is considered the link between the body and the cosmos, symbolizing the connection between the individual soul and the universal consciousness. The name Nabhya carries the meaning “Lord of the Navel” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nabhya usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the navel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the connection between the individual and the universe.
data.etymology: Nabhya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Navel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabhya total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
